title: runstate v0.1 wire-format messages
description: Canonical schema for runstate v0.1 messages. Defines the wire format for cooperative bidirectional control between an orchestrator and a long-running worker. Other-language implementations validate against this schema.

command_id.description: 48-bit random hex; uuid4().hex[:12]. Collision probability negligible below ~1M commands per run.

Command.description: Orchestrator → worker. Discriminated by 'type'. Carries a command_id for ack tracking.

StopNow.description: Ask the worker to stop ASAP at its next safe point.

StopAtStep.description: Ask the worker to stop when its current step reaches `at`. Deferred preempt: the worker decides when based on its own step counter.

Progress.description: Periodic report of training state. Send as often as orchestrator visibility requires. step is optional for workers without a step concept.

metrics.description: Numeric values keyed by metric name. Non-numeric values are not protocol-conformant; users wanting richer payloads should send a custom message via raw Channel.

Stopped.description: Worker's self-described exit notification. Send immediately before exiting. reason is free-form string; common values: 'natural', 'preempted', 'diverged', 'nan_detected', 'patience_triggered', 'oom'.

Ack.description: Worker acknowledgment that a command was received and acted on. Auto-sent by the worker's check helper when it returns a non-None command. Carries the original command's command_id so the orchestrator can match acks to sent commands.

of.description: The type field of the acknowledged command. Redundant with command_id but convenient for pattern-matching by command type.
